cv.name: Wesley Holloway
cv.headline: Manufacturing / Area Manager | Food & beverage packaging | Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
cv.summary: Industrial engineer with eight years on the plant floor in packaging and food manufacturing around Atlanta. I run multi-shift production areas, coach supervisors and use lean tools to hit safety, throughput and cost targets.

experience.title: Mfg Mgr (Area Mgr – Packaging)
bullets: Own packaging operations for 6 lines across 3 shifts with 4 supervisors and 95 hourly associates
Raised OEE on the two highest-volume lines from 61% to 72% through changeover reduction (SMED)
Lead daily tiered meetings and monthly cost reviews with the plant manager
Partner with maintenance on a preventive maintenance rollout in SAP PM

experience.title: Ops Lead II
bullets: Ran second shift for an injection molding area with 14 presses
Cut scrap by about 20% with the quality team

experience.title: Prod. Supv. – 2nd Shift
bullets: Supervised 25 operators on corrugators and converting lines
